novelty.justification: The novelty route is a mechanistic relationship: the claim predicts that a generic forecasting transformer encodes a conserved quantity as a "linear direction that remains approximately invariant along a trajectory" and that removing it "degrades long-horizon rollout stability more than short-horizon accuracy." Searches for "transformer hidden representations conserved quantities," "neural network latent invariant direction energy conservation," and "probing learned dynamics conservation laws" identify the closest prior work as Wetzel et al., Discovering Symmetry Invariants and Conserved Quantities by Interpreting Siamese Neural Networks (2020), alongside established methods that explicitly discover or impose invariants, but not the same forecast-model representation and causal horizon-selectivity hypothesis. Moving from those works to linear probing and residual-stream ablation in an autoregressive transformer is a substantive multi-step adaptation rather than a direct transfer, although it combines familiar invariant discovery, probing, and ablation principles rather than introducing an entirely new interpretability paradigm.
